<div style="max-width: 100%; font-family: sans-serif; color: #fff; line-height: 1.6;">
<!-- 📢 HEADER --> <div style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0F3460, #1A1A2E); padding: 24px; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 24px;"> <h1 style="color: #00FF88; margin: 0; font-size: 22px;">📢 ABISO SA MGA NAG-AABANG</h1> <p style="color: #888; margin: 8px 0 0 0; font-size: 13px;">Martodosko Audio Studio — Kasalukuyang Ginagawa<br>Updated: 2026-09-19</p> </div>
<!-- 📊 PROGRESS --> <div style="background: #1E1E2F; padding: 20px; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px;"> <h2 style="color: #40E0D0; margin-top: 0; font-size: 18px;">📊 KASALUKUYANG ANTAS — ~30% TAPOS</h2>
<div style="background: #2A2A3C; border-radius: 6px; height: 10px; margin: 12px 0;"> <div style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00FF88, #40E0D0); width: 30%; height: 100%; border-radius: 6px;"></div> </div>
<h3 style="color: #4CAF50; font-size: 15px; margin: 16px 0 8px 0;">✅ TAPOS NA — PUNDASYON</h3> <ul style="margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; font-size: 14px; color: #CCC;"> <li>Buong sistema ng menu at paglipat ng screen</li> <li>Custom na pihitan — neon glow, indikasyon, auto-save</li> <li>Vocal Channel — Gain at Sensitivity</li> <li>Auto Update System mula sa GitHub</li> <li>Gabay at dokumentasyon</li> </ul>
<h3 style="color: #FFC107; font-size: 15px; margin: 16px 0 8px 0;">⏳ GINAGAWA — DETALYADONG MIXER</h3> <ul style="margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; font-size: 14px; color: #CCC;"> <li>Lahat ng pihitan sa Vocal Channel — 12+ na kontrol</li> <li>Guitar Effects — Distortion, Wah-Wah, Chorus, at iba pa</li> </ul>
<h3 style="color: #F44336; font-size: 15px; margin: 16px 0 8px 0;">🔴 HINDI PA NASISIMULA — PUSO NG PROYEKTO</h3> <ul style="margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; font-size: 14px; color: #CCC;"> <li>Preset System — Save & Load</li> <li>Pedal Interface — 3-knob control sa Home Screen</li> <li>Audio Engine — C++ low-latency processing <10ms</li> </ul> </div>
<!-- 🎨 INAASAHANG PAGBABAGO --> <div style="background: #1E1E2F; padding: 20px; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px;"> <h2 style="color: #40E0D0; margin-top: 0; font-size: 18px;">🎨 INAASAHANG DISENYO</h2>
<div style="display: grid; gap: 12px; font-size: 14px; color: #CCC;"> <div style="background: #2A2A3C; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px;"> <b style="color: #00FF88;">🖥️ Pedal Board —</b> Ang Home Screen ay magiging pisikal na pedal board </div> <div style="background: #2A2A3C; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px;"> <b style="color: #40E0D0;">🎚️ Mixer Tabs —</b> Mabilis na lipat: 🎤 Vocal ↔ 🎸 Guitar </div> <div style="background: #2A2A3C; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px;"> <b style="color: #FFD700;">📋 Preset Preview —</b> Makikita ang pedal bago piliin </div> <div style="background: #2A2A3C; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px;"> <b style="color: #FF6B6B;">⚡ Real-time Audio —</b> Naririnig agad habang pinipihit </div> </div> </div>
<!-- 🎯 LAYUNIN --> <div style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2C003E, #1A1A2E); padding: 20px; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px;"> <h2 style="color: #FFD700; margin-top: 0; font-size: 18px;">🎯 ANG LAYUNIN NATIN</h2> <ul style="margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; font-size: 14px; color: #F0E68C;"> <li><b>TOTOONG MABILIS —</b> <10ms na antala, halos hindi maririnig</li> <li><b>DIREKTANG DALOY —</b> Mikropono → Pandinig, walang pagkaantala</li> <li><b>PARA SA LAHAT —</b> Boses man o gitara, libre at walang bayad</li> </ul> </div>
<!-- 🙏 PANGWAKAS --> <div style="text-align: center; padding: 20px; color: #888; font-size: 13px; font-style: italic;"> 🙏 MARAMING SALAMAT SA PAGTITIIS<br><br> <span style="color: #00FF88; font-size: 15px;">"Ang musika — para sa lahat, kahit saan."</span><br><br> Patuloy tayong gagawa — para sa inyo. </div>
</div>
